svg.title: The First Five Minutes: Crisis Intervention & Grounding Skills
svg.desc: Poster for the MindCare Services two-hour live online workshop on crisis intervention and grounding skills for clinicians. Rapid crisis triage, core grounding protocols, a guided case simulation and clinical interview preparation. PKR 2,000, live on Zoom, with an e-certificate and a PDF protocol toolkit.
svg.text: “A client starts dissociating or panicking in your office —
what do you do in the first five minutes?”
